config_name: iPad Air 11-inch — M4 8-core CPU / 9-core GPU, 12GB RAM, 512GB SSD, 11" Liquid Retina + Magic Keyboard

specs.display_type: Liquid Retina IPS LCD (fully laminated, anti-reflective, no ProMotion)
specs.ports: 1x USB-C (USB 3 10Gb/s, DisplayPort), magnetic Magic Keyboard connector, Smart Connector
specs.keyboard_notes: Magic Keyboard for iPad Air 11" included in price: scissor keys with full function row (unlit), glass trackpad, cantilever hinge
specs.pen_support: Apple Pencil Pro +$168.99 (BBY sale; ~$199 Apple) — not included in total; Pencil USB-C +$99; hover supported

battery.notes: 28.93Wh cell. Apple claims 10h web/video Wi-Fi (9h cellular); users report ~8h mixed real-world use on the 11".

price.notes: Tablet-only $1,429.00 (apple.com/ca, verified 2026-11-24) + Magic Keyboard Air 11" $379.99 (BBY 19204080). Cellular variant +$200 ($1,629 tablet). Pencil Pro not included.

reviews.quote: The fiercest competitor for the iPad Pro is home-made. Pros: brute top performance, WiFi very fast, high-quality unibody chassis, USB-C with 10 GBit/s, two external displays possible, good color accuracy (PWM-free), well-balanced speakers, high recycled content. Cons: slow 60 Hz display, battery charging takes time, SoC throttles under sustained load. (NBC review of the iPad Air 13" M4 2026; 11" shares SoC and chassis design.)

praises: 512GB in a 464g body: the travel creator's config — full ProRes project libraries offline in a jacket pocket (r/ipad)
M4 media engine handles ProRes/AV1 timelines that embarrass thicker Windows tablets
12GB unified memory keeps Stage Manager + external 6K display setups app-reload-free
Fully laminated anti-reflective panel with P3/True Tone is easy on the eyes all day
Wi-Fi 7 + BT 6 + Thread is the same radio stack as the Pro
complaints: 60Hz at $1,800-with-keyboard is the wall every buyer hits before considering the Pro
500-nit panel is the line's dimmest; 13" buyers get 100 more nits
Storage step to 512GB costs $280 — Apple's soldered-tax complaint applies here
Unlit Magic Keyboard keys; single 10Gb/s port needs a dock
iPadOS ceiling: no desktop-class apps, and the 11" screen is tight for Stage Manager windows

design_philosophy: The capacity-maxed small Air: same silent M4/12GB machine as every tier, with enough internal storage that the most portable iPad in the lineup stops needing external drives. It's the config for people who chose size over screen and refuse to compromise on room.
